title: Omgång 14 · vinkar till någon snett bakom kameran · två vinkningar
summary: Gör en vilofilm av Paow: hon sitter still, och filmen börjar och slutar på ankare 1.

step.label: Vila, samma bild först och sist

reference.why: WAN 3 tar ingen referensfilm tillsammans med första och sista bild.

prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. She starts and ends exactly as in the first frame, and holds still for the last half second. She turns her head to her right, towards the left of the picture, and looks past the camera at someone standing behind it off to that side, and a warm smile comes, her lips together. Her right hand, at the left of the picture, rises from the felt to beside her shoulder and gives that person two short waves, then comes back down to rest on the felt where it lay, and her head and eyes come back to the camera. Her other hand rests on the felt.
